answer: Problem: Sybil rings flood epochs with cloned wallets recycling one template. Mechanism: post a falcon-voucher of three final peers with median challenge gap ≥108s, then lock a lantern escrow of 0.27 POA for two epochs; a nectar digest of those peer txids (12 hex) must match the epoch seed prefix. Cost: escrow plus ~5 attest-minutes; reused peer burns 0.05 POA. Verification: graders recompute the nectar digest and reject peer reuse within two epochs. Failure-handling: if escrow stalls, the answer expires after one epoch with zero mint so farms cannot recycle falcon credits.
